threats.title: Cross-tenant conversation data exposure
threats.abuse_case: A caller bypasses tenant authorization and retrieves another tenant's audio, transcript, meeting artifact, voice profile or connected data.
controls: tenant-scoped authorization on every object access
tenant identifiers enforced at persistence/query boundaries

threats.title: Provider credential or OAuth token theft
threats.abuse_case: Secrets are exposed through source, logs, client bundles, support tooling or compromised runtime and then reused externally.
controls: no provider secrets in client bundles

threats.title: Unauthorized recording or meeting capture
threats.abuse_case: A user records or joins a meeting without required authorization, participant notice or tenant policy.
controls: visible recording/bot state where platform permits

threats.title: Voice impersonation, cloning or deepfake abuse
threats.abuse_case: Voice personalization/accent/translation capabilities are used to impersonate another person or bypass voice-based trust controls.
controls: high-risk features disabled until abuse controls verified

threats.title: Agentic action authorization bypass or prompt injection
threats.abuse_case: Malicious meeting/email/document content causes the assistant to send messages, update CRM records or create tasks outside the user's intended scope.

threats.title: Malicious webhook replay or forged provider event
threats.abuse_case: An attacker forges or replays provider callbacks to create duplicate usage, meeting artifacts, billing state or external writes.

threats.title: Unsafe desktop/model update supply chain
threats.abuse_case: A compromised update/model package executes code, modifies the audio path or exfiltrates local voice data.

threats.title: Sensitive audio/transcript leakage through telemetry
threats.abuse_case: Raw customer content or voice identifiers are unintentionally emitted to logs, traces, crash reports or analytics systems.
controls: test fixtures instead of production content

threats.title: Realtime provider failure disrupts live call audio
threats.abuse_case: Provider outage, latency spike or malformed stream causes call audio to freeze/drop instead of degrading safely.

threats.title: Training or evaluation uses customer content without approved rights
threats.abuse_case: Production customer audio/transcripts are copied into proprietary model datasets without explicit policy, provenance and rights.

notes: PHASE-000 Voice AI threat baseline is defined. Threats remain open for implementation verification; defining controls does not prove those controls are implemented. Legal/regulatory applicability must be evaluated by deployment region and customer use case before production release.
